routes.name: R_NHB_IMPORT_DSV
routes.reason: Theorem 1.6 concerns continuous functions on a fixed Euclidean domain with locally uniform convergence and a viscosity equation. Those are not supplied for the moving normalized heights. The manuscript does not invoke that theorem.

C9000081.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 081 (Riesz transforms and rectifiability in higher codimension.; papers: Riesz transforms and uniform rectifiability in higher codimension; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/081.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

NHB_GOAL.statement: Proposition prop:height-equation follows from its stated hypotheses, with the same height and subsequence, without graph, density-regularity, or convergence-rate assumptions.
NHB_GOAL.scope_note: Complete analytic proof available; independent review pending. Only NHB_FORMAL has kernel evidence.

NHB_PAIRINGS.statement: Upper n-growth gives absolutely convergent Lipschitz-cancelled mean-zero Riesz pairings and an exterior error O(T^-1), as in lem:pairings.

NHB_WEAK.statement: The uniform support-centered lower bound and weak plane limit imply qualitative local support tubes and convergence on bounded continuity regions.

NHB_ALGEBRA.statement: The cutoff square identity and the finite weighted pairwise-variance identity hold with the stated signs and factors.

NHB_HORIZON.statement: For delta_j=2^-j and K_j=2j+3, delta_j^-1 2^-K_j=2^(-j-3); delta_j 2^(gamma K_j) tends to zero for 0<gamma<1/2.

NHB_ENERGY.statement: Lemma lem:height-energy: the centered unnormalized-height test gives uniform local L2 and fractional energy for u_j/delta_j.

NHB_COMPACT.statement: Lemma lem:moving-compactness: finite projection partitions give convergence of ordinary, signed, and squared measures on one subsequence.

NHB_DIAGONAL.statement: Capped product kernels pass to the same height, and the uncapping error is uniformly O(h^(1/2)) by bounded energy.

NHB_TAIL.statement: The normalized exterior is bounded by C(T^-1+T^(gamma-1)+delta_j^-1 2^-K_j), and the limiting weighted tail is integrable.

NHB_MEAN.statement: With one localization and one subtraction point, the nonzero-mean bump pairing converges and c_j tending to zero suffices; no rate or bound on w_j(0) is used.

NHB_FRACTIONAL.statement: The limiting renormalized pairing is the absolutely convergent integral of v times Lg for every compact smooth mean-zero intrinsic test.

NHB_FORMAL.statement: Universal cutoff and finite-variance algebra, rate-free normalized mean correction, and two-stage vanishing-error convergence; not a formalization of the measure-theoretic bridge.
NHB_FORMAL.scope_note: Lean 4.31.0 compiler and axiom audit passed; natural-language fidelity still needs independent review.

NHB_LIT_DSV.statement: Primary-source comparison only: arXiv:1610.04663v1 Definition 1.1 and Theorem 1.6 use a weighted tail and a cutoff equation modulo polynomials; their stability hypotheses are not the moving-measure hypotheses.
NHB_LIT_DSV.dependency_note: A checked scope comparison, not an external assumption used by NHB_GOAL.

NHB_LIT_REL.statement: Primary-source comparison only: arXiv:1104.4345v3 Section 7 proves fixed-domain fractional compactness, not by itself the moving-measure squared-moment conclusion.
NHB_LIT_REL.dependency_note: Prior art only; the moving-measure theorem is independently proved.

NHB_QUADRATIC.statement: With all other bridge hypotheses unchanged, the bound D delta_j^2 (Lip xi+1) for the same mean-zero tests already gives uniform normalized energy, moving squared-moment compactness, and the same limiting fractional equation.
NHB_QUADRATIC.scope_note: Stronger oscillation-exponent theorem proved directly in Sections 1-6; not a novelty or main-theorem claim.

NHB_LOWER_NECESSARY.statement: Without a common support-centered lower n-growth bound, plane-volume plus t_j^2 times a parallel sheet and height t_j^-1 on that sheet has bounded local energy and norms but an off-plane squared-moment defect, despite weak convergence to plane volume.
NHB_LOWER_NECESSARY.scope_note: A counterexample only to a weakened statement. It violates an explicit manuscript hypothesis and does not refute lem:moving-compactness.

NHB_PLANE_MOMENTS.statement: Lemmas lem:plane-comparison and lem:fixed-plane-moments give a single affine reference plane over the finite horizon.

NHB_WEIGHTED_RIGIDITY.statement: Lemma lem:fractional-rigidity: the measurable mean-zero fractional weak equation and weight (1+|x|)^(-n-2) force an affine function.

NHB_PLANAR_RIGIDITY.statement: Lemma lem:planar-rigidity identifies full support and constant positive planar density.

NHB_FLAT.statement: Proposition prop:flat-limit supplies the constant-density full-plane limit and compatible affine normal coordinates.

NHB_POLARIZATION.statement: Lemmas lem:affine-polarization and lem:normal-affine-planes turn the same limiting affine heights into genuine approximating planes.

NHB_NORMALIZED_EXCESS.statement: Proposition prop:normalized-excess-limit gives vanishing relative excess and bilateral flatness on the common subsequence.

NHB_PROPAGATION.statement: Theorem thm:excess-propagation is the uniform relative-excess implication used by the packing proof.

NHB_OSC_PACKING.statement: Proposition prop:oscillation-packing supplies Carleson control of oscillation-bad cells; not audited in this mission.

NHB_FLAT_SEEDS.statement: Proposition prop:flat-seeds supplies flat descendants outside a Carleson family; not audited in this mission.

NHB_BETA_PACKING.statement: Lemma lem:seed-charging and Proposition prop:beta-packing convert propagation and flat seeds to bilateral geometric packing; not audited in this mission.

NHB_BWGL.statement: The stated David-Semmes BWGL endpoint converts bilateral geometric packing to the specified ball-map uniform rectifiability; not audited or imported here.

NHB_MAIN.statement: Theorem thm:main: uniform hard Riesz-truncation L2 boundedness implies quantitative uniform n-rectifiability for integers 2<=n<=d-2.
